The Alpha Covenant is the third Covenant. It revolves around [[childrearing]], [[apotheosis]] and [[cosmic victory]].

It centers on growth and creation and is the highest covenant<ref>https://evolution.faith/alpha-covenant/</ref>
It is considered to be the middle point of [[Olalo]]

It is run by the [[Alpha Priesthood]]

== Before Resurrection ==
Before [[the Resurrection]] the Alpha Covenant will focus mainly on [[childrearing]], and to a lesser extent general leadership of the [[Church of Evolution|Church]]. 

== After Resurrection ==
After [[the Resurrection]] the focuses will shift to [[apotheosis]] and [[cosmic victory]].
